import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList, useDnD, type MultipleMode } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import FileItem from './FileItem.vue';

const files = ref([
  { id: 'brief', name: 'brief.pdf', kind: 'pdf', size: '220 KB' },
  { id: 'logo', name: 'logo.svg', kind: 'img', size: '8 KB' },
  { id: 'budget', name: 'budget.xlsx', kind: 'xls', size: '64 KB' },
  { id: 'hero', name: 'hero.png', kind: 'img', size: '1.2 MB' },
  { id: 'notes', name: 'notes.md', kind: 'doc', size: '3 KB' },
  { id: 'deck', name: 'deck.key', kind: 'pdf', size: '9.8 MB' },
  { id: 'avatar', name: 'avatar.jpg', kind: 'img', size: '140 KB' },
  { id: 'terms', name: 'terms.md', kind: 'doc', size: '12 KB' },
]);

const MODES: MultipleMode[] = ['group', 'gaps', 'stack'];
const mode = ref<MultipleMode>('group');
const layout = ref<'list' | 'grid'>('list');

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
// Both are read when a drag starts: switch them between drags.
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, {
  items: files,
  multiple: mode,
  strategy: () => (layout.value === 'grid' ? 'grid' : 'vertical'),
});

// The click rules are the app's: a click selects one file, Ctrl/Cmd-click adds or
// removes one, Shift-click selects the run from the last clicked file.
const { selection } = useDnD();
let anchor: string | null = null;
const pick = (id: string, event: MouseEvent) => {
  const ids = items.value.map((file) => file.id);
  if (event.shiftKey && anchor) {
    const [a, b] = [ids.indexOf(anchor), ids.indexOf(id)];
    selection.set(ids.slice(Math.min(a, b), Math.max(a, b) + 1));
    return;
  }
  if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) selection.toggle(id);
  else selection.set([id]);
  anchor = id;
};
selection.set(['logo', 'hero', 'notes']);
</script>

  const stay = source.filter((file) => !ids.includes(file.id));
  if (from) folders.value.find((entry) => entry.id === from)!.files = stay;
  else home.value = stay;

  last.value = { ids, from, to };
  selection.clear();

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import PostCard from './PostCard.vue';
import { pickCover, type Choice, type Post } from './posts';

const props = defineProps<{
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Asks what to do with posts without a cover; only lists that need one ask. */
  ask?: (missing: Post[], ready: number) => Promise<Choice>;
}>();
const posts = defineModel<Post[]>('posts', { required: true });

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.id,
  items: posts,
  group: 'blog',
  // A scheduled post needs a cover. Dropped with posts that have none, the list asks what
  // to do, and the drop waits for the answer: every post (covers added), the ready ones
  // (the keys returned; the others fly back), or none.
  onBeforeDrop: async (event) => {
    const missing = event.items.filter((post) => post.cover === null);
    if (!props.ask || event.sameList || !missing.length) return true;
    const choice = await props.ask(missing, event.items.length - missing.length);
    if (choice === 'cover') missing.forEach((post) => (post.cover = pickCover()));
    if (choice === 'ready') return event.keys.filter((_, index) => event.items[index]!.cover !== null);
    return choice === 'cover';
  },
});
</script>

const emit = defineEmits<{ notice: [text: string] }>();

/** Room left for these cards: those already in the column don't count twice. */
const room = (keys: Key[]) => props.column.limit! - props.column.cards.filter((card) => !keys.includes(card.id)).length;
const full = computed(() => !!props.column.limit && props.column.cards.length >= props.column.limit);

// Over a column with a limit, the pile gets a badge: does it fit? A function is a
// functional component: it hands FitBadge what only the column knows.
const fit: FunctionalComponent<OverlayProps> = (overlay, { slots }) =>
  h(
    FitBadge,
    {
      count: overlay.items.length,
      room: room(overlay.items.map((item) => item.id)),
      limit: props.column.limit!,
      status: overlay.status,
    },
    slots,
  );

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableList(list, {
  id: props.column.id,
  items: toRef(props.column, 'cards'),
  group: {
    name: 'board',
    // A full column takes nothing: over it the pile turns red (CardPile).
    put: ({ keys, from, to }) => !props.column.limit || from === to || room(keys) > 0,
  },
  // The other picked cards fly into the overlay: a pile.
  multiple: 'stack',
  overlay: CardPile,
  overOverlay: props.column.limit ? fit : undefined,
  // Room for some of them: the column takes as many as fit, the others fly back.
  onBeforeDrop: (event) => {
    const { limit } = props.column;
    if (!limit || event.sameList) return true;
    const free = room(event.keys);
    if (free >= event.keys.length) return true;
    emit('notice', `${props.column.name} took ${free} of ${event.keys.length}: WIP limit ${limit}`);
    return event.keys.slice(0, free);
  },
});
</script>

<template>
  <section class="column" :class="{ over: isOver, full }">
    <h3>
      {{ column.name }}
      <span class="count">{{ column.cards.length }}<template v-if="column.limit"> / {{ column.limit }}</template></span>

import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';

import MailRow from './MailRow.vue';
import MailOverlay from './MailOverlay.vue';

const mails = ref([
  { id: 'm1', from: 'Maya Chen', subject: 'Design review at 3' },
  { id: 'm2', from: 'Airline', subject: 'Your boarding pass' },
  { id: 'm3', from: 'Leo Park', subject: 'The build is green' },
  { id: 'm4', from: 'Hotel Aurora', subject: 'Booking confirmed' },
  { id: 'm5', from: 'Nora Kim', subject: 'Slides for the demo' },
]);
const done = ref({ archive: 0, trash: 0 });

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
// Every drag of the list shows MailOverlay: one summary for one or many mails. The box is
// centered on the pointer (`snapCenterToCursor`), and the summary hangs off its middle.
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, { items: mails, overlay: MailOverlay, modifiers: [snapCenterToCursor] });

const { selection } = useDnD();
selection.set(['m2', 'm4']);

// The zones take the mails out of the inbox: `source.remove()` drops them from the list.
const into = (zone: 'archive' | 'trash') => (event: DnDEvent) => {
  done.value[zone] += event.active.ids.length;
  event.source?.remove();
  selection.clear();
};
const archive = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('archive');
const trash = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('trash');
// Each zone's `data` says what a drop there does: the overlay reads it from `over`.
const { isOver: overArchive } = makeDroppable(archive, { id: 'Archive', data: { verb: 'Archive' }, onDrop: into('archive') });
const { isOver: overTrash } = makeDroppable(trash, { id: 'Trash', data: { verb: 'Delete', danger: true }, onDrop: into('trash') });
</script>
